criteria.finding: Both instruments are usable as printed. Each carries a pre-response consent/privacy notice, a voluntary-participation statement, a three-way field-zone legend (示範值 / REAL 空白欄位 / 管理者專用欄位) and the 1–5 plus N/A scale legend with a check column. Status handling is complete and mutually exclusive on both forms — 未回應 (with an instruction that it has no form, must not be ticked and must not be treated as negative), 撤回, 待補正之未完成, 無效, 有效 — each with an instruction and a single-choice format, plus 判定備註 and 管理者簽核（若經授權）left blank. Privacy and storage are left explicitly UNKNOWN/NOT PROVIDED with a candidate control list (§8.3, PDF p.34) rather than asserted. Hold/reject criteria exist per SOP step and in the §8.1 decision table (可計算／暫緩／排除單份／抑制次分群／不得升格 REAL, PDF p.34), including the prohibition on auto-triggering a failure verdict or CAPA from a single unapproved percentage (PDF p.6). The SOP gives ten steps with input, candidate operation/control, output and hold/reject conditions, with P-01 gating on a known population and invitation denominator, P-02 gating release on authorised tool approval, P-04 separating invitation/delivery/nonresponse/return, P-05 separating撤回/待補正/無效/有效 with traceable status changes, and P-10 gating claims of established storage. The dictionary gives nine coded entries with denominator, numerator, source form and limits (including MISSING_ITEM, NA_TREATMENT and SUB_SUPPRESS), and the formula library gives six reproducible formulae with a zero-denominator N/A guard and explicit rounding rules. The worked case is complete and self-consistent end to end. Ranked recommendations exist at §7.2 with a documented six-rule ranking rule, an explicit decision criterion (10/14 positive, mean 3.93/5) and the sensitivity caveat. The tracking table separates 合成觀察 / 成因狀態 / 改善建議 / 後續核驗方式 / 建議責任職能 / 建議負責人 / 預定期限 / 狀態 into independent columns with fill rules ①–④ that forbid naming a person, forbid assumed deadlines and forbid writing 已改善 without verifiable follow-up data, plus a blank TRK- log table for ongoing use. The PDCA block adds per-stage hold/close criteria and requires at least two options before selection. Recommendations remain distinct from authorization throughout: stage 4 requires verified decision authority, every proposal is marked as requiring authorised adoption, and 實際指派未核定 / 姓名未提供 / 期限未定 remain in place.
